dialogue.instruction: Trabaja en equipo con el Constructor Max. Lee lo que dice y elige la respuesta correcta en cada turno.

turns.npc: Hi! Can you help me build a house?
Great! Let's work together. Can you bring the blocks?

options.text: Sure, I bring the block five.

turns.npc: Nice job! Now we put the blocks together. Are we a good team?

options.text: Yes, we are a good team!
Yes, we is a good team!
Yes, we a team good are!

turns.npc: We did it! The house is finished. Thank you, friend!

options.text: You are welcome! We did it together.
You are welcome! We did it alone.
You welcome are! Together it did we.
